CLARIFICATIONS:
(i) All documents and reports have been corrected to use the correct descriptions and terminologies and the necessary documents resubmitted
(ii) There are 3 bodies running the Unified Cardano Student Club, the mentors, the national supervisory council and the national student council. The difference between them as stated in the proposal is that the mentors are like coaches that help the student learn about cardano for example we have the developer mentor who is helping the students in learning plutus and other Cardano stacks, the national supervisory council are cardano members in Nigeria who are providing leadership to the student leads, while the national student council are student directly leading the affairs of the club in Nigeria.
(iii) Ratification of the draft of the national supervisory council is not within the scope of this project, what we have done is provide the drafts to the respective councils, but they are to adapt it as it deem fit to them after deliberatio
